a_key_or_a_password_or_both: A key or a password, or both.
a_viewer_sees_projects_inventories_templ: A viewer sees projects, inventories, templates, jobs, and workflows.
an_administrator_manages_organizations_t: An administrator manages organizations, teams, users, settings, and backup. The team role is not checked.
an_operator_launches_jobs_and_maintains_: An operator launches jobs and maintains projects, inventories, templates, workflows, and webhooks.
an_owner_also_manages_credentials_enviro: An owner also manages credentials, environments, and members.
create_a_template_or_a_workflow_first: Create a template or a workflow first.
empty_inventories: Inventories list the hosts a playbook runs on.
empty_jobs: Jobs appear here after you launch a template, a workflow, a schedule, or a webhook.
empty_projects: Projects bring playbooks and OpenTofu files from a path or a Git repository.
empty_sets_the_domain_to_default: Empty sets the domain to Default.
empty_templates: Templates combine a project, an inventory, and credentials into a job you can launch.
jobs_workflows_and_alerts_for_several_te: Jobs, workflows, and alerts for several teams. Local account or LDAP.
leave_empty_to_keep_the_password: Leave empty to keep the password.
maintenance_mode_banner: Maintenance mode: database migration in progress.
move_database_to_postgresql_hint: Move this SQLite installation to an empty PostgreSQL database. SQLite stays the default and the source file is never changed.
name: Name
netbox_credential_address_hint: Inventory sources use this address. A NetBox credential without an address cannot be used.
no_new_jobs_during_maintenance: No new jobs start. Existing jobs may still finish. Restart Koreograf on the new database after the migration.
opentofu_apply_confirmation_body: Start OpenTofu apply for "{name}"? It keeps the saved state and can change resources.
opentofu_plan_reads_state_apply_keeps_it: plan reads the saved state and does not change resources. apply keeps that state for this team and template on the controller. A remote backend is what to use when the state should leave this machine.
preflight_no_runtime_and_tool_missing: No container service found and {tool} is missing. {templates} templates cannot run. Install {install} on this machine or start Docker or Podman and use an execution environment.
preflight_project_missing: {tool} is missing. Git projects cannot sync. Install {install} on this machine.
preflight_project_unusable: {tool} could not be checked. Git projects cannot sync. Install {install} on this machine.
preflight_ready: The runner has every tool that the configured mode needs.
preflight_runtime_missing: No container service found. Ansible, OpenTofu, and Shell templates with an execution environment cannot run. Start Docker or Podman, or install the local tools.
preflight_runtime_not_answering: The container runtime is installed but the daemon does not answer. Ansible, OpenTofu, and Shell templates with an execution environment cannot run. Start Docker or Podman, or install the local tools.
preflight_runtime_timeout: The container runtime did not answer. Ansible, OpenTofu, and Shell templates with an execution environment cannot run. Start Docker or Podman, or install the local tools.
preflight_tool_missing: {tool} is missing. {templates} templates cannot run. Install {install} on this machine.
preflight_tool_too_old: {tool} {version} is older than {minimum}. {templates} templates cannot run. Install a newer {install} on this machine.
preflight_tool_unusable: {tool} could not be checked. {templates} templates cannot run. Install {install} on this machine.
route_error_explanation: The address may be outdated or the object may belong to another team. Try again, or open the overview.
route_error_title: This page could not be loaded.
schedule_empty_template: This template has no schedule yet.
source_control_credential_hint: For HTTPS, put a personal access token in the password field.
the_job_sees_the_host_username_and_passw: The job sees the host, username, and password. Docker itself is not logged in.
the_tag_part_is_invalid_letters_digits_a: The tag “{part}” is invalid. Letters, digits, and _ . : - are allowed.
this_account_has_no_team_an_administrato: This account has no team. An administrator creates one under Team.
this_field_needs_a_valid_value: This field needs a valid value.
